posts.t:
My plan is to keep doing these on EURUSD hourly/5min until I am up to the present. Might not ever get there, though!

11: DBR

11a. This tight DBR has created a spike, leading to a strong decision to break higher, shown as the 'DP'. There is no immediate retest of the DP (even on the M5) and in fact when price does return, it goes deeper into the zone on the first visit than a DP retest would.

The reaction at 11b is very strong, giving a good rejection back up to the zone discussed previously (circled) that had the supply eaten away.

In addition, there are these features, too. I think the compression would be clearer if I had M1 data back this far.
posts.fa:
5min قصد دارم این‌ها را روی EURUSD در تایم یک‌ساعته و 5 دقیقه ادامه بدهم تا به زمان حال برسم. هرچند شاید هرگز نرسم!

11: DBR

11a. این DBR فشرده یک اسپایک ساخته که به تصمیم قوی برای شکست به بالا انجامیده و با «DP» نشان داده شده است. ریترِیس فوری‌ای برای DP وجود ندارد (حتی در M5) و در واقع وقتی قیمت برمی‌گردد، در اولین بازدید عمیق‌تر از آنچه ریترِیس یک DP باشد وارد ناحیه می‌شود.

واکنش در 11b خیلی قوی است و ریجکشن خوبی به سمت بالا تا همان ناحیه‌ای می‌دهد که قبلاً بحثش شد (دور گرفته شده) و عرضه‌اش خورده شده بود.

علاوه بر این، این ویژگی‌ها هم هست. فکر می‌کنم اگر داده M1 را تا این حد عقب داشتم، فشردگی واضح‌تر دیده می‌شد.

Quick answers are yes, and yes. Exactly. I initially had "engulf" written instead of "entered", but I wanted to be clearer about what was going on. Other than the fact that this move enters into the compression, it's not a particularly important engulf, as it engulfs a mid-level high. You may want someone more qualified to check that, though.

posts.t:
Hey, you're doing what we did when we got here, and I continue to do. Ask questions, learn, answer questions. The spirit of RTM. I'm not much further down the road then you are. The reason I draw the high at the extreme is pretty obvious, but I also look back in time to see if there's something obvious price might shoot for during a fake out.

The significance of the break of the previous candle's low is that it is the point where price has "decided" to go lower, and so is a significant point, and one which the market (I am realising) likes to test to see if there are more orders sat there. It'll all come together for us, I'm sure.

13: RBD

On the hourly there are two obvious rejections, so I'd like to take a look at the inside.

On the M5 we can see a pole up to the first high, which has a pause on the way up - a flag (a RBR on a smaller TF, most likely). Price then moves up to form the first high we see on the H1. On the way dow from this high price compresses a bit, before dropping to break the FL, so we should look for an oportunity to short down to the base of the pole. That opportunity first comes at x, but as we have had the compression at 13a (stacked supply) we should be wary of a move to the edge of the zone - and this happens at y. We than have the move down to the pole base/decision to create the pole, at z.

Ok, so this is maybe not so easy a trade to take on this TF, but on the M1 I'm sure someone like Kruger would nail it!

OK, so not a particularly fine example, but it's interesting to note that that the second H1 candle has no wick, ie open=high. I've heard this refered to as "pure supply", so it must be worth paying attention to. Of course, with this one I'll need to go to the M5 to see what's up. By this point, though, I should be getting the idea that I need to target the DBR from example 12, shown in pink.

The M5 shows a flag limit being broken at x, and the test of this decision happening at y. Price doesn't manage to close above the FL line, and this is followed by an engulf at z, so things are looking OK for a possible drop on return the the RBD. The move away from 14a wasn't particularly strong, but there is good supply from what is likely an M1 FTR, creating the white zone shown. There is a strong move into the zone at 14b (I have taken the high at y to be the bottom of the zone) and a decent rejection. There's no clear PA on this TF to take a short, but a TT would have worked.

One the Hourly this appears as a spike, and the M5, also, but let's taker a look at any reason to go long, here.

On the M5, firstly, there is no immediate test of the zone, so I'm starting to think that maybe we need to wait for that test, then go long depending on what we see. Often it is a second trip into the zone, taking out the extreme of the first visit. Is this a stop hunt, which occurs the majority of the time?

On this example we have x, which looks good to take a long on its close, but it is the first move into the zone. We have the engulf above saying price could go higher.

On the second trip into the zone, at y, there's a good pin bar as a long signal.

17: DBR

This, again, isn't a strong drop, but there is a clean bottom to the two candles, and a strong move away. The move away could be considered more important, as it shows the strength of S/D imbalance. Time at the zone is important, and price does hang around there a bit, and the imbalance is helped out by the compression shown. Perhaps this would not be a good place to look for a long entry, and price does not move very far from the zone, as drawn. There is a good hourly rejection on the return, though, and some CP into the demand zone.

On the M5 we can see a reasonably strong move up, and the retrace from this is the test of the hourly break, and happens right where the hourly zone was drawn. so, I would now be looking for a deep test into the zone. This is backed up by the compression in the zone, rather than a strong move away prior to the break.

At 17b, the reaction has an initial trip into the zone, of which I am learning to be wary. The second, deeper visit has a pin bar right at the bottom, which is a valid reason to enter. Should you wait, then you have an engulf, and a QM entry.

این هم دوباره ریزش قوی‌ای نیست، ولی دو کندل کف تمیزی دارند و حرکت قوی‌ای از آن ناحیه دور می‌شود. این دور شدن را می‌توان مهم‌تر دانست، چون قدرت عدم تعادل عرضه/تقاضا را نشان می‌دهد. زمان ماندن در ناحیه مهم است و قیمت واقعاً کمی آنجا معطل می‌شود، و فشردگی نشان‌داده‌شده به عدم تعادل کمک می‌کند. شاید اینجا جای خوبی برای دنبال ورود خرید گشتن نباشد و قیمت، همان‌طور که کشیده شده، خیلی از ناحیه دور نمی‌شود. ولی در بازگشت، ریجکشن خوبی در تایم یک‌ساعته داریم و مقداری CP به داخل ناحیه تقاضا.

در M5 حرکت صعودی نسبتاً قوی‌ای می‌بینیم و ریترِیس بعد از آن همان تست شکست تایم یک‌ساعته است و دقیقاً همان‌جایی اتفاق می‌افتد که ناحیه یک‌ساعته کشیده شده بود. پس حالا دنبال تست عمیقی به داخل ناحیه می‌گردم. این با فشردگی داخل ناحیه پشتیبانی می‌شود، نه با حرکت قوی دور شدن پیش از شکست.

در 17b واکنش یک سفر اولیه به داخل ناحیه دارد که دارم یاد می‌گیرم مراقبش باشم. بازدید دوم و عمیق‌تر یک پین‌بار دقیقاً در کف دارد که دلیل معتبری برای ورود است. اگر صبر کنی، اینگالف هم داری و یک ورود QM.
